entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No.125/2024 registered at Police Station, Malanpur, District Bhind, (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 323, 454, 376, 450, 120 of IPC.
2. The allegation against the applicant is of committing rape with the prosecutrix.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 29.05.2025.
First application has been dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 05.11.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.38994/2024.

Thereafter prosecutrix,
her parents and other six witnesses have been examined before the learned trial Court.
The parents of the prosecutrix turned hostile and did not support the story of prosecution at all.

Though prosecutrix has supported the story of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:8243 2 MCRC-10970-2025 prosecution in chief examination, but in cross-examination she denied the allegation against present applicant stating that some unknown person has committed rape on her.

It is also submitted that DNA report is not positive in respect of vaginal swab or cloth of the prosecutrix, but it is positive in respect of hair of present applicant while there is no seizure of hair on record, therefore, DNA report also becomes doubtful.
There is no criminal history against the applicant.
He is ready and willing to comply with any condition which may be imposed by the Court.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On these grounds, learned counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
4 . Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

sentences.text: 6 . Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and attending facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
In case, if he is found involved in the offence of same nature, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to the Bench.

v) The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial;
vi) The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR VANI) JUDGE ms/-
